about_the_game:
Office Platoon is a tactical, physics-based, monster catching game where you'll lead a squadron of sentient office supplies to do your dirty work, all in the name of survival. Where did these whimsical little creatures come from? Why are they so happy-looking in such a dreary office? Jerboa Insurance Group hides many secrets, and to find them you'll need to keep your job.

  • Recruit Adorable Creatures

    Any monster you encounter can be captured with a...fishing rod? With the help of a strange spirit living inside the walls, you can collect them all.

  • Meet and Betray Your Co-Workers

    You may all be working at the same company, but the lowest performer gets laid off each week. Will your outwork your competition with honesty and integrity, or throw them under the bus to save your own skin? 

  • A Tactical RPG with Physics

Battles feature more than just taking cover from enemy fire. The environment is full of intractable objects to take advantage of. Hazards you can push enemies into, heavy objects to crush them with.  But be careful, they can do the same to you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: 1.7+ Ghz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD5450 or better; 256 MB or higher
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX9.0c compatible sound card and drivers

short_description: Office Platoon is a physics based tactical RPG where you'll capture living office supplies, recruit them to your army, and lead them into battle. Fight to keep your job at a company obsessed with layoffs and you might just live long enough to find out they're really hiding.
